line: It went smooth. The pay's thin. Let's find something that doesn't leave us both tired.
That one's behind us. Paid what it was worth. Not much, but at least it didn't cost us.
It closed clean, and the coin's light. Don't expect more than what's in the pouch, Shiny.
It went through clean. Paid little. I'm not happy with the rate, but I'm not arguing the work.
No risk, no reward. This one's a loss. Let's find work that doesn't bleed us dry.
No one got hurt, but the pay was low. I'll mention it once.
This one didn't cost us, but it didn't pay us either. Not sure why we did it.
Low risk, low pay. I don't complain about the risk, but I do about the pay.
This one's pay doesn't even cover the time. Don't expect it to again.
Low pay, low risk. I don't make a habit of this, Shiny.
No one got hurt. The numbers still suck. Let's find something that doesn't.
This one didn't cost much, but it didn't pay much either. Not my favorite kind of math.
Small take, no injuries. Job's done. Pay's not even enough to make me say it was worth it.
Shiny. It paid what it had to. Not a drop more, and not a drop less.
Nobody got hurt. The pay was thin. That's the job, not the rate.
Nobody bled. The number's low. I don't pretend it was anything else.
It went smooth. It paid like it was a favor. I'll take the favor, but I won't take the rate.
Small money for small work. No complaints, but don't expect it again.
No danger, no return. This one's a loss. Not a lot, but enough to notice.
Safe work, low pay. No complaints, but I'd rather have more of the first and less of the second.
